SELECT product_name, price FROM products ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM categories;

SELECT product_name, price 
FROM products 
ORDER BY price ASC 
LIMIT 1;
SELECT first_name, last_name FROM employees WHERE manager_id IS NULL;
SELECT p.product_name, c.category_name FROM products p JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id WHERE c.category_name = 'Laptops';

SELECT e.first_name, e.last_name, d.department_name
FROM employees e
JOIN departments d ON e.department_id = d.department_id
WHERE d.department_name = 'Sales';

SELECT o.order_id, o.order_date, o.status
FROM orders o
JOIN employees e ON o.handled_by = e.employee_id
WHERE e.first_name = 'Julia' AND e.last_name = 'Becker'

SELECT p.product_id, i.quantity
FROM products p
JOIN inventory i ON p.product_id = i.product_id
JOIN warehouses w ON i.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id
WHERE w.warehouse_name = 'Munich Regional Warehouse'

SELECT p.product_name, oi.quantity 
FROM products p 
JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id 
WHERE oi.quantity > 2

SELECT p.product_name, i.quantity 
FROM products p 
JOIN inventory i ON p.product_id = i.product_id 
WHERE i.quantity < 30;

SELECT o.order_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, o.order_date
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE c.city = 'Munich';

SELECT oi.order_id, oi.product_id, oi.quantity, oi.unit_price
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.status = 'cancelled'
SELECT p.product_name, c.category_name FROM products p JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id WHERE c.category_name = 'Audio';

SELECT e.first_name, e.last_name, d.department_name
FROM employees e
JOIN departments d ON e.department_id = d.department_id
WHERE d.department_name = 'Fulfillment';

SELECT o.order_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, o.status
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND c.country = 'Germany';

SELECT i.product_id, i.quantity 
FROM inventory i 
JOIN warehouses w ON i.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id 
WHERE w.warehouse_name = 'Hamburg Fulfillment Center' 
  AND i.quantity > 100

SELECT DISTINCT p.product_name, oi.unit_price
FROM products p
JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
WHERE oi.unit_price > 500
SELECT p.product_name, c.category_name FROM products p JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id WHERE c.category_name = 'Fitness Equipment';

SELECT d.department_name, COUNT(e.employee_id) AS employee_count
FROM departments d
LEFT JOIN employees e ON d.department_id = e.department_id
GROUP BY d.department_id, d.department_name;

SELECT 
    p.product_name, 
    SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_sold
FROM 
    products p
JOIN 
    order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
GROUP BY 
    p.product_id, 
    p.product_name
ORDER BY 
    total_sold DESC
LIMIT 5;
SELECT YEAR(order_date) AS order_year, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY YEAR(order_date) ORDER BY order_year;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS laptop_customers
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE p.product_name LIKE '%laptop%'

SELECT 
    c.category_name, 
    COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 0) AS revenue
FROM 
    categories c
LEFT JOIN 
    products p ON c.category_id = p.category_id
LEFT JOIN 
    order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
GROUP BY 
    c.category_id, 
    c.category_name

SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count
FROM customers c
LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name;

SELECT e.first_name, e.last_name, COUNT(o.order_id) AS orders_handled
FROM employees e
LEFT JOIN orders o ON e.employee_id = o.handled_by
GROUP BY e.employee_id, e.first_name, e.last_name

SELECT w.warehouse_name, SUM(i.quantity) AS total_stock
FROM warehouses w
LEFT JOIN inventory i ON w.warehouse_id = i.warehouse_id
GROUP BY w.warehouse_id, w.warehouse_name

SELECT c.category_name, AVG(p.price) AS avg_price
FROM categories c
LEFT JOIN products p ON c.category_id = p.category_id
GROUP BY c.category_id, c.category_name;

SELECT c.category_name, COUNT(p.product_id) AS product_count
FROM categories c
LEFT JOIN products p ON c.category_id = p.category_id
GROUP BY c.category_id, c.category_name

SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name
HAVING COUNT(o.order_id) > 3;

SELECT 
    c.category_name, 
    SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue
FROM 
    categories c
JOIN 
    products p ON c.category_id = p.category_id
JOIN 
    order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
JOIN 
    orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE 
    o.status != 'Cancelled'
GROUP BY 
    c.category_id, 
    c.category_name
HAVING 
    SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) > 5000;
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY status;
SELECT p.product_name, SUM(i.quantity) AS total_units FROM products p JOIN inventory i ON p.product_id = i.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY total_units DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT 
    c.category_name, 
    AVG(oi.unit_price) AS avg_sold_price
FROM 
    categories c
JOIN 
    products p ON c.category_id = p.category_id
JOIN 
    order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
GROUP BY 
    c.category_id, 
    c.category_name;

SELECT e.first_name, e.last_name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS smartphone_sales
FROM employees e
JOIN orders o ON e.employee_id = o.handled_by
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id
WHERE c.category_name = 'Smartphones'
GROUP BY e.employee_id, e.first_name, e.last_name
ORDER BY smartphone_sales DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_spent
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name
HAVING SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) > (
    SELECT AVG(customer_total)
    FROM (
        SELECT SUM(oi2.quantity * oi2.unit_price) AS customer_total
        FROM customers c2
        JOIN orders o2 ON c2.customer_id = o2.customer_id
        JOIN order_items oi2 ON o2.order_id = oi2.order_id
        GROUP BY c2.customer_id
    ) AS avg_table
);
SELECT product_name, price, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY price DESC) AS price_rank FROM products;

SELECT p.product_name
FROM products p
LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
WHERE oi.product_id IS NULL;

SELECT p.product_name, p.price, c.category_name
FROM products p
JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id
WHERE p.price = (
    SELECT MAX(p2.price)
    FROM products p2
    WHERE p2.category_id = p.category_id
);

SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 0) AS total_spent, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 0) DESC) AS spend_rank FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name ORDER BY total_spent DESC, c.last_name, c.first_name

SELECT oi.order_id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS order_value
FROM order_items oi
GROUP BY oi.order_id
HAVING SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) > (
    SELECT AVG(order_total)
    FROM (
        SELECT SUM(quantity * unit_price) AS order_total
        FROM order_items
        GROUP BY order_id
    ) AS avg_table
);

SELECT DISTINCT c.first_name, c.last_name
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN inventory i ON p.product_id = i.product_id
JOIN warehouses w ON i.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id
WHERE p.product_name LIKE '%laptop%'
  AND w.warehouse_name = 'Berlin';

SELECT 
    c.first_name, 
    c.last_name, 
    p.product_name, 
    oi.quantity, 
    oi.unit_price, 
    (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS line_total
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN (
    SELECT c2.customer_id
    FROM customers c2
    JOIN orders o2 ON c2.customer_id = o2.customer_id
    JOIN order_items oi2 ON o2.order_id = oi2.order_id
    GROUP BY c2.customer_id
    ORDER BY SUM(oi2.quantity * oi2.unit_price) DESC
    LIMIT 1
) top_cust ON c.customer_id = top_cust.customer_id;
